units.signed_well_depth_m: m; negative below surveyed ground elevation

guardrails.donor_population: other wells from each well's first observed day onward, excluding listed sparse gate wells
guardrails.unanchored_right_edge_gaps: causal/provisional; no future observation is used

selection.method: median nested held-out-water-year bias weight by well and gap-length class
selection.class_rule: smallest class greater than or equal to the contiguous gap length; use 180 for longer gaps

calibration.interpretation: RMSE is hybrid blocked-gap error; p80/p95 retain conservative raw-GBT empirical radii
